decisions.reason: The candle arch builds on the firm's core skills in turning, carving and assembly, and the added light and sound modules are a manageable extension it can learn to refine.
A one-tier pyramid sits squarely within the firm's traditional craft knowledge, so it can easily interpret demand and improve the product.

Although the electronics lie further from the firm's core knowledge, this flagship line with interchangeable discs is a strategic direction the firm has invested in learning, and it anchors the motif platforms.
This licensed-story platform is already a 'second edition' tied to outside content the firm cannot develop itself, so it is likely to be replaced by new motifs rather than kept.
The Christmas motif fits the firm's seasonal core market and gives recurring Christmas demand, so it is likely to stay as an add-on to the music box line.
A themed pyramid draws directly on the firm's long-standing pyramid know-how and serves its collector customers, making it a low-risk product to keep.
